QF.id: SIA Assessment Frameworks Techniques and Standards_33

question.text: SAS-100 issued by the ICAI Social Impact Assessment Standards Board (SIAB) is BEST described as:

answer.text: The overarching standard governing how a Social Impact Assessor conducts an SIA engagement — planning, risk assessment, evidence, documentation, review, and reporting including URN issuance
A sector-specific indicator catalogue for healthcare
A SEBI disclosure circular for listed equities

explanation.text: The Logic: SAS-100 is the umbrella engagement standard for SIAs under ICAI SIAB — it defines planning the engagement, performing risk assessment, collecting sufficient appropriate evidence, documenting working papers, review, issuing the SIR/AIR and assigning the Unique Reference Number (URN). Sector-specific indicators live in SAS-200/400/500/1100/1300 etc. The Trap: Options B, C, D misplace SAS-100. Sector indicators, tax rules and SEBI circulars are distinct instruments. Cross-Exam Context: XXIII uses SAS-100 as the engagement-process backbone throughout. Other exams do not reference SAS-100 — it is unique to XXIII. Assessor's Pro-Tip: Keep a SAS-100 procedure checklist at the front of every engagement file — it protects you against ICAI peer-review findings if the assessment file is later pulled for quality-control review.
